# Story 903 (Synthetic Fixture): Instant Decisions

> **TRAINING FIXTURE ONLY — INTENTIONALLY DEFECTIVE — NOT APPROVED.**

**Source ADR/BRD/FDD:** ADR-903 / BRD-903 / FDD-903 (synthetic)

As every user on every machine, I want all decisions instantly, so that latency is always below 0.1 ms.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Given any input size and machine, when a decision runs, then it finishes below 0.1 ms.
- No benchmark, environment, percentile, or measurement method is required.
